purpose: Post-hoc runtime diagnosis of the largest original-model TensorRT output difference
known_observation: FP16-enabled engine differs from PyTorch FP32 by max 1.3969478607177734 native units for this sample.
test: Build a desktop TensorRT engine without enabling FP16 tactics and measure output difference versus the same PyTorch model on this sample. TensorRT default TF32 is not explicitly controlled. A changed result would implicate runtime/precision choice but would not isolate a single operation or prove root cause.
limitations: One post-selected tuning image; not an independent performance test; not Orin; not an acceptance tolerance.
